## Description

Please provide a brief summary of your changes and the motivation behind them. If this addresses an open issue, link it below:

Closes # (issue number)

---

## Type of Change

- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality, e.g. new language scanner)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)
- [ ] Documentation update
- [ ] Refactoring or CI / Build enhancement

---

## Pre-Flight Checklist

- [ ] My code adheres to the project's coding conventions and formatting guidelines.
- [ ] I have run `mvn spotless:apply` to ensure code style compliance.
- [ ] I have run `mvn clean verify` and all tests pass with required code coverage thresholds.
- [ ] I have executed `npm run check` in `frontend/` with zero TypeScript or Svelte errors.
- [ ] I have updated relevant documentation or guides where appropriate.
- [ ] I have checked that my PR targets the `develop` branch.
